decisions.reason: The product shows concrete customer value with a quantified annual saving claim and fits the firm's modular recycling-systems direction, so the option value of continuing clearly outweighs the low cost of keeping it on the market.

A dedicated product page suggests a meaningful commercial commitment, and as a new mobile machine in a growing recycling-equipment market it is still too early and too uncertain to justify abandonment.

Because it is described as a flagship and aligns directly with the firm's stated strategic path toward modular environmental technology, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it after only one year.

This product has weaker visible market evidence than the others, but it still fits the core portfolio and in a growing firm the cost of keeping such a recent launch available is likely modest relative to its remaining upside.
